x: Robin Weate, in his first big race for us, shewed that he will be a very useful asset by finishing 28th. Charlie Dabbs was disappointing in 44th position but has been unfit and was short of training.

The juniors ran in the same race and Charlie Dabbs and Robin Weate followed Archie round, closely pursued by Eddie Short and Clive Shippen. The brothers Bishop (Alan and Eric) indulged in some good pack running with Jim Heathfield and Bob Glover in attendance.

Len Orton, our second claim member from Birchfield, was prominent and Robin Weate was also well placed. Eric Gebbett seemed to be taking an easy start but at the next appearance had worked his way through the field.
With about two miles to go, J.Masters, who had been forcing the pace for most of the race, fell back rapidly, and was quickly passed by Gebbett, R.Weate and L.Bishop.

The race took place over good grassland over a distance of five miles and Robin Weate and J.Dooley ran together to finish second and third. Gerry Lines made one of his rare appearances and showed welcome form to finish 9th.
John Moore, by finishing 52nd, gained good experience in a large field and Robin Weate, in his first year with us, showed that he is possessed of more than his fair share of pluck to finish 88th.
Another good run was that of Robin Weate who was 21st. In the youths race Belgrave were 10th.The only other news we have is that C.Thompson was 26th and J.Thresher 48th.

In John Moore, Ken Jones and Robin Weate we have a acquired runners of high quality and Club Spirit and the improvement of George Flanagan, Peter Hitchcock, Clive Shippen and Bob Glover promises well for the future.
